title: Tiny, cute treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow glow under chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2b1f5e'/>
  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='56' height='32' rx='4' fill='#c07a2c'/>
  <!-- body wood plank shading -->
  <rect x='22' y='52' width='56' height='32' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#e8a94e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='26' y='56' width='48' height='8' rx='2' fill='#a8661f'/>
  <rect x='26' y='70' width='48' height='8' rx='2' fill='#a8661f'/>
  <!-- silver bands -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='56' height='4' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
  <rect x='22' y='78' width='56' height='4' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='56' height='2' fill='#f2f2ff'/>
  <rect x='22' y='78' width='56' height='2' fill='#f2f2ff'/>
  <!-- lid -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q22 34 50 34 Q78 34 78 52 Z' fill='#d98c38'/>
  <path d='M22 52 Q22 34 50 34 Q78 34 78 52 Z' fill='none' stroke='#f0b25c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <path d='M28 50 Q28 40 50 40 Q72 40 72 50' fill='none' stroke='#f7cc8a' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- silver band on lid center -->
  <rect x='47' y='34' width='6' height='18' fill='#d8d8f0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='2' height='18' fill='#f2f2ff'/>
  <!-- lock plate -->
  <rect x='43' y='56' width='14' height='16' rx='2' fill='#f5d24b'/>
  <rect x='43' y='56' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#fff08a'/>
  <!-- keyhole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='63' r='3' fill='#8a5a1a'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='64' width='3' height='5' fill='#8a5a1a'/>
  <!-- little gems peeking -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='4' fill='#4be0d0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#c8fff8'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='49' r='3.5' fill='#ff6fb5'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='49' r='1.3' fill='#ffd0e6'/>
  <!-- tiny feet -->
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9a5c1a'/>
  <rect x='64' y='82' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9a5c1a'/>
</svg>
